thread:
**Issue #3547 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #3547: Patch: Stinkyscape+ S09, the Minerals
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

Part of fullsend 1 of the Stinkyscape+ set (#3534, tracker #3533). It builds the Minerals (one-mana Spells that give a Unit something) and Cryofluid.

The plan: [`docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9/docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md) (SP5, SP6, SP8, SP10); the designer's list: [`JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9/JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md). Both are on the planning branch `claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9` until the foundation (#3535) brings them onto this fullsend's branch. Where they disagree with SPEC, SPEC wins (CLAUDE.md). `{For AI: …}` notes in the designer's text are the designer's notes to you, the builder, not to the game's AI (SP5).

## Cards

| # | Card |
| --- | --- |
| #22 | Cryofluid |
| #44 | Blast Compound |
| #45 | Surge Alloy |
| #46 | Phase Fabric |
| #47 | Plastanium |
| #48 | Thorium |
| #49 | Metaglass |
| #50 | Graphite |

## What it builds on

- The foundation (#3535): every card's catalog entry, both faces and a stub script.
- E3 (#3543): Frenzy and Evasive.

## Readings (defaults; change one only with a ruling note)

- #22 Cryofluid: one Mindustrial tag (the list says it twice).
- #44 Blast Compound: "lock the tile it is on" is §6.3 Lock on that Unit's zone.
- #45 Surge Alloy: "Rush attack" means Rush (Radiant: Charge).
- #46 Phase Fabric: the Radiant face's "Can't be Attacked" is Evasive (E3).
- #50 Graphite: "Piece" means Pierce (SP5). "Frenzy this may attack again" is E3's Frenzy.

## The designer's text, verbatim

```text
**(1) Cryofluid, Spell, Mindustrial, Rare, Mindustrial, Stinkyscape+, #22**
Give a Unit +6/+6, **Deft**, and **Freeze** it.
~~~
Give a Unit +12/+12, **Deft**, and **Freeze** it.

**(1) Blast Compound, Spell, Mindustrial, Mineral, Rare, Stinkyscape+, #44**
Give a unit **+2** attack and **Cleave**, **lock** the tile it is on
~~~
Give a unit **+6** attack and **Cleave**, **lock** the tile it is on

**(1) Surge Alloy Spell, Mindustrial, Mineral, Legendary, Stinkyscape+, #45**
Give a unit **Rush** attack and **Windfury**
~~~
Give a unit **Charge** attack and **Windfury**

**(1) Phase Fabric Spell, Mindustrial, Mineral, Epic, Stinkyscape+, #46**
Give a unit **Immutable** and **Immune to Spells**
~~~
Give a unit **Immutable, Immune to Spells,** and **Can’t be Attacked**

**(1) Plastanium Spell, Mindustrial, Mineral, Epic, Stinkyscape+, #47**
Give a unit **+2** health and **Divine Shield**
~~~
Give a unit **+6** health and **Divine Shield**

**(1) Thorium Spell, Mindustrial, Mineral, Epic, Stinkyscape+, #48**
Give a unit **+5/+5** and **Brittle 1**
~~~
Give a unit **+10/+10** and **Brittle 1**

**(1) Metaglass, Spell, Mindustrial, Mineral, Rare, Stinkyscape+, #49**
Give a unit **Ranged**
~~~
Give a unit **Ranged** and **+3** attack

**(1) Graphite, Spell, Mindustrial, Mineral, Rare, Stinkyscape+, #50**
Give a unit **Piece, Deft, Frenzy** this may attack again
~~~
Give a unit **Piece, Deft, Frenzy** this may attack again, & **First Strike**
```

## Done when

- [ ] Every card above plays its base and Radiant faces by its text and the readings, in its own script file (`crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/cNNN_slug.rs`, the stub the foundation made), with tests for both faces in the same file (CLAUDE.md rules 5 and 6). `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` was read first (rule 10).
- [ ] Every number is a named constant or a card `param` (rule 9). A script reads state only through the prelude's helpers. A missing verb or board fact goes into the engine with its test (CLAUDE.md, Architecture).
- [ ] Each decision the spec doesn't make has a ruling note numbered in this issue's block, a test named after it, and its paragraph in `spec/pending/<this issue>.md` (rule 3). The cards' §8 rows say what was built.
- [ ] Every prompt these cards open is answered by the AI, the random policy and the timeout.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-cards` passes for these cards, and `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `spec check` and `names --check` pass.
- [ ] Only these cards' catalog entries and §8 rows are edited (other parts edit theirs side by side), and the set stays `Held`: players see nothing until the release (part R).

Blocked by #3543

Part of #3534.

## Plan

_Written by `muse` (muse, `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42858802660)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Build all eight Stinkyscape+ Mineral/Cryofluid Spells (#22, #44–#50) from their stubs: each script plays its base and Radiant faces exactly by its designer text plus the issue's readings, with per-face tests in the same file. Every number stays a declared catalog `param`; no engine or AI changes; new §8.12 rows, ruling notes in this issue's block, and all gates green while the set stays `Held`.

## Files to touch

| File | New/change | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/c022_cryofluid.rs` | change | `targets()` + base/radiant `cry` (buff, Deft grant, Freeze); header; tests |
| `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/c044_blast_compound.rs` | change | `targets()` + `cry` (attack buff, Cleave grant, `lock` of chosen zone); header; tests |
| `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/c045_surge_alloy.rs` | change | `targets()` + `cry` (Rush/Windfury base, Charge/Windfury radiant); header; tests |
| `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/c046_phase_fabric.rs` | change | `targets()` + `cry` (Immutable + Immune to Spells; radiant adds Evasive); header; tests |
| `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/c047_plastanium.rs` | change | `targets()` + `cry` (health buff + Divine Shield); header; tests |
| `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/c048_thorium.rs` | change | `targets()` + `cry` (buff + `give_brittle`); header; tests |
| `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/c049_metaglass.rs` | change | `targets()` + `cry` (Ranged; radiant adds attack buff); header; tests |
| `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/c050_graphite.rs` | change | `targets()` + `cry` (Pierce + Deft + Frenzy; radiant adds First Strike); header; tests |
| `crates/cards/catalog.json` | change | `loc` of the 8 entries only, from `cargo jackioh catalog loc` |
| `spec/08-catalog.md` | change | 8 new single-line §8.12 rows (#22 after #10; #44–#50 after #119, before #143) with Engine cells ending `Built by S09 (#3547).` |
| `spec/pending/3547.md` | new | §11 paragraph(s) for each new ruling, in `pending/3543.md`'s style |
| `spec/rulings/R3547NNN.md` | new | Ruling notes in block R3547000–R3547999 (lowest free first), only for gaps the build finds |

Do not touch: `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`, `crates/engine/`, `crates/ai/`, `apps/web/`, other cards' entries or rows, `census.rs`, `card-text.yaml`, audio, fx tables, or `patches/pending/` (a held set needs no fragment). Governing spec: §8.12, §6.1 (Deft, Cleave, Rush, Charge, Windfury, Immutable + `restrictions::immutable_bars`, Evasive, Divine Shield, Brittle counts, Ranged, Pierce, Frenzy, First Strike, Frozen), §6.3 (stat buff, Freeze, Lock, Give vs gain Brittle), R81/R430 (declared targets), R1420 (held set), R1748003/R2261001 (params).

## Steps

1. Read first (rule 10): `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md`, `docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md` SP5/SP8/SP10, `JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md` lines 325 and 506–541, `spec/pending/3543.md` with `spec/rulings/R3543000.md`–`R3543003.md` (E3: Evasive, Frenzy), and copy the shape of `training_grounds/c012_fortify.rs` (buff + grants to any Unit, `param(&*ctx, …)`), `stinkyscape/c003_meteor.rs` (`lock` after the text's effect, `{"zone": {"of": "chosen"}}`), and `stinkyscape/c001_freeze_ray.rs` (`freeze({target: {of: chosen}})`).
2. In every script: replace the header with the card's §8.12-style header (text of both faces, verbs, rulings cited); set `targets()` to `vec![TargetDecl::target(1, 1, json!({ "side": "any", "of": ["unit"] }))]` (R81: any Unit either side, never the hero; Meteor/Fortify precedent — rejected: enemy-only or hero picks); keep `use jackioh_engine::prelude::*;` and the `ID`. Every number comes from `param(&*ctx, "key")`; effects run in the text's order. If any needed verb or board fact is missing from the engine, stop and add it in `crates/engine` with its own fixture test per `ADDING_CARDS.md` §6 — none is expected to be missing.
3. `c022_cryofluid.rs`: base `cry` returns `buff({target:{of:chosen}, attack: param buff, health: param buff})`, `grant_keyword({target:{of:chosen}, keyword:{kind:Deft}})`, `freeze({target:{of:chosen}})`; radiant identical with `buff2`. Freeze passes Immutable (R1174000) with no extra code.
4. `c044_blast_compound.rs`: one `cry` for both faces returning `buff({target:{of:chosen}, attack: param attack})`, `grant_keyword({…{kind:Cleave}})`, then `lock(json_as(json!({ "zone": { "of": "chosen" } })))` (counters.rs `lock`, ZoneSpec::Chosen — Meteor/Jammed precedent; rejected: `lock_played_zone`, which is for arrival triggers). Param `attack` tunes 2 → 6 across faces.
5. `c045_surge_alloy.rs`: base grants `{kind:Rush}` and `{kind:Windfury}`; radiant grants `{kind:Charge}` and `{kind:Windfury}`. Declares no numbers (catalog has no params). No exertion code: sickness exemption is the keywords' own engine behavior.
6. `c046_phase_fabric.rs`: base grants `{kind:Immutable}` and `{kind:"Immune to Spells"}`; radiant adds `{kind:Evasive}` (R3543002: implies Can't Defend without adding it). `grant_to` has no guards, so no engine change; Immutable units are auto-excluded from offers (R781001).
7. `c047_plastanium.rs`: one `cry` returning `buff({target:{of:chosen}, health: param health})` and `grant_keyword({…{kind:"Divine Shield"}})` (fortify's spent-shield revival comes free). Param `health` tunes 2 → 6.
8. `c048_thorium.rs`: base `buff` attack/health from `buff` plus `give_brittle({target:{of:chosen}, n: param brittle2})`; radiant same with `buff2`. Use `give_brittle` (set to N, §6.1/R385 — rejected: `gain_brittle`, which adds).
9. `c049_metaglass.rs`: base grants `{kind:Ranged}` only; radiant grants Ranged plus `buff({attack: param attack})`. The catalog's `attack` param is `tunedOn: radiant`, so the base face never reads it (R2261001).
10. `c050_graphite.rs`: base grants Pierce, Deft, Frenzy (`{kind:Pierce}`, `{kind:Deft}`, `{kind:Frenzy}` — "Piece" is Pierce per SP5); radiant adds `{kind:"First Strike"}`. Frenzy itself is E3's engine behavior (R3543003); the card only grants the keyword.
11. Delete each file's stub test; write `mod tests` with `mod base` / `mod radiant` (fortify/meteor shape: `scenario()`, `s.play(ID, pick::instance)`, `s.expect_stats`, keyword counts via `KeywordKind`, `upgrade_number` for one param per tuned card). Name ruling-pinning tests `r3547NNN_…`; other names are descriptive.
12. Run `cargo jackioh catalog loc crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/cNNN_slug.rs` for all 8 and write the 8 `loc` values into `catalog.json`; change nothing else there (texts/params already match the readings).
13. Add the 8 §8.12 rows in numeric position, each ending `Built by S09 (#3547).`, citing the verbs and rulings used (copy #3544's row density: one line per card).
14. For each genuine spec gap the build relied on, write `spec/rulings/R3547NNN.md` (lowest free from R3547000; front matter `id/title/cards/proven_in` per `spec/README.md` "Adding a ruling"), name the proving test `r3547NNN_…`, list the file in `proven_in`, and add its paragraph to `spec/pending/3547.md`. Likely candidates, all following Hearthstone semantics: tile = the target's unit zone locked after the buff (Meteor precedent); "Piece" = Pierce and "Frenzy this may attack again" = the Frenzy keyword; "Rush/Charge attack" = granting that keyword (sickness rules unchanged). Keep the issue's readings otherwise; changing one needs its own note.
15. Run: `cargo fmt --check`; `cargo clippy -p jackioh-cards --all-targets -- -D warnings`; `cargo test -p jackioh-cards c022_cryofluid` (and one run per other slug: `c044_blast_compound`, `c045_surge_alloy`, `c046_phase_fabric`, `c047_plastanium`, `c048_thorium`, `c049_metaglass`, `c050_graphite`); `cargo jackioh catalog check`; `cargo jackioh patches check`; `cargo jackioh spec check`; `cargo jackioh names --check`; then `cargo jackioh fuzz --seeds 20 --cards stinkyscapeplus-022` and the same for each of the other seven ids (random policy + timeout coverage; CI runs the 200-seed changed-cards wave).

## Tests

- `c022_cryofluid.rs`: base `offers_any_unit_neither_hero`; base `stats_up_6_6_and_deft_and_frozen`; radiant `stats_up_12_12_and_deft_and_frozen`; one `upgrade_number` param test; `r3547NNN` only if a freeze/buff-order gap is ruled.
- `c044_blast_compound.rs`: base/radiant `attack_up_N_cleave_and_zone_locked` (assert `attack` +2/+6, Cleave present, `view.locks` set at the target's lane, occupant unaffected); `r3547000_tile_is_the_targets_unit_zone_locked_after_the_buff`; `upgrade_number` for `attack`; enemy-unit target allowed.
- `c045_surge_alloy.rs`: base `rush_and_windfury_no_charge`; radiant `charge_and_windfury_no_rush`; base `windfury_attacks_twice` (two declared attacks land); radiant `charge_may_attack_hero_first_turn` vs base `rush_refused_the_hero` (sick unit, R81/R636 behavior).
- `c046_phase_fabric.rs`: base `immutable_and_immune_no_evasive`; radiant `evasive_added` + `r3547NNN` if ruled; `attacks_cannot_target_it_but_effects_reach_it` (attack refused per R3543002; a second buff still offers it).
- `c047_plastanium.rs`: base/radiant `max_health_up_N_and_divine_shield` (+2/+6 with damage kept); radiant `shield_eats_first_hit` (chosen-by-the-sun pattern); `upgrade_number` for `health`.
- `c048_thorium.rs`: base/radiant `stats_up_and_brittle_1` (`card.brittle == Some(1)`, attack/health +5/+5 / +10/+10); `give_not_gain` if ruled (pre-set count replaced per R385 — only if a helper card provides one cheaply, else assert `Some(1)` alone).
- `c049_metaglass.rs`: base `ranged_and_no_attack_change`; radiant `ranged_and_plus_3_attack`; radiant `takes_no_strike_back` (R783000; attacker takes 0 from a non-Ranged defender).
- `c050_graphite.rs`: base `pierce_deft_frenzy_no_first_strike`; radiant `first_strike_added`; `frenzy_kill_grants_another_attack` (E3 fixture pattern in `crates/engine/tests/rules/flexible_evasive_frenzy.rs`); `r3547NNN_piece_is_pierce` if ruled.
- Commands: `cargo test -p jackioh-cards <slug>` per file; `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `spec check`, `names --check`; `cargo jackioh fuzz --seeds 20 --cards <id>` per id.

## Done when

- [ ] All 8 scripts play both faces by text + readings, tests per face in-file; `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` read first.
- [ ] All numbers are `param`s; scripts read state only via prelude helpers; no engine/AI/client changes (or engine gap added with its test).
- [ ] Every spec gap has its `R3547NNN.md` note, `r3547NNN_…` test, and `spec/pending/3547.md` paragraph; §8.12 rows say what was built.
- [ ] All prompts (one declared target each) need no new AI/random/timeout handling — verified by green card tests + per-card fuzz waves, as #3544 did with no AI change.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-cards` green for the 8 slugs; `catalog check`, `patches check`, `spec check`, `names --check` pass; set still `Held`; only these cards' entries/rows edited.

## Risks

- Thaw timing in Cryofluid tests: assert Frozen right after the play with a filler in hand (freeze-ray pattern), or the cleanup thaws it before the assert.
- Brittle assertions: assert the count (`Some(1)`), never multi-turn tick timing (`BRITTLE_FIRST_TICK_TURNS` skips a cycle).
- Immutable offers: never write a test offering an Immutable unit a buff spell — R781001 bars it by design.
- Evasive + Taunt: granting Evasive to a Taunt unit is legal; no test should expect Taunt to bind.
- Fuzz draws use these cards once landed: a fuzz failure naming another card is filed, not hidden, with a corpus record per `ADDING_CARDS.md` §4.

## Open questions

None. All readings are stipulated in the issue; the builder records the tile→zone, Piece→Pierce, and Rush/Charge-attack mappings as rulings only where the spec is genuinely silent, and rejects nothing the task requires.
````
